approach: Keep enlarged Audiveris melody recognition fixed and add a conservative image-derived chord-text recognition and structured harmony conversion stage.
objective: On the seven first-per-song pilot excerpts, recover missing printed chord symbols from the region above the staff using enlarged-image OCR and a strict chord grammar. Convert roots, qualities, explicit extensions and slash basses into a parseable editable kern harmony spine. Preserve existing melody events; record chord bounding boxes and proposed onset alignment separately, marking ambiguous timing for review. Do not infer absent symbols from musical plausibility or consult references.
success_criteria: Produce sealed parseable predictions for all seven pilot images, source code and per-image diagnostics distinguishing OCR failures, unsupported chord syntax and uncertain onset alignment. Compare protected chord edit error and matches with enlarged Audiveris baseline (30/38 errors, 8 matches), and verify melody error does not increase from 87/130 errors. Include round-trip parse checks and synthetic transposition checks for melody, chord roots and slash basses; distinguish these checks from measured transcription correctness. Report timing as unaudited.
